summary.description: One paragraph (2-4 sentences) framing the learner's program. Surfaced on the Home Dashboard hero card.

duration_weeks.description: Estimated total program duration in weeks. Null if duration depends on outcomes rather than calendar time.

normalized_topic.description: Lowercase canonical slug for the topic (e.g. 'haskell', 'organic_chemistry'). Used for retrieval; null if no clean slug fits.

stages.description: All stages of the program, in order. Each stage is one coarse phase the learner moves through.

intent.description: One sentence describing what this stage moves the learner toward.

first_stage_sprints.description: Sprints inside the FIRST stage. Stages 2+ are not expanded yet.

title.description: Like 'Sprint 1 · Reading and Writing Pure Functions'.

focus.description: One-sentence focus the learner can hit in a few days.

first_sprint_sessions.description: Sessions inside the FIRST sprint of the FIRST stage. Each session is one teachable unit, ~15-30 minutes.

first_session_blocks.description: Full ordered block list for the FIRST session. Must include at least one of each kind: title, objective, concept, example, multiple_choice, short_answer, reflection, checkpoint, review_card. For programming topics also include code_exercise.
